effectContract.compoundException: ${terms.technology.agentSwarm} is the only card that resolves additional Core Actions.

escalations.name: ${terms.technology.megaCluster}
escalations.text: Spend 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and 2 ${terms.resources.compute} to place a ${terms.technology.megaCluster} across two adjacent connected Facilities you own. Add 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. It produces 3 ${terms.resources.compute} during Production while both hosts remain adjacent and connected. No additional Power is assigned.
escalations.flavorText: The campus joins a substation, algae reactors, fungal utility meshes, and water rights into one regional obligation.

escalations.name: Reorganization
escalations.text: Move every Agent up to one hex. You may return one Agent for 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. This does not ready or resolve another Action.
escalations.flavorText: Every eliminated role is recorded as a successful transfer of institutional memory to the system that made it redundant.

escalations.name: Public Capability Covenant
escalations.text: Every player gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. You gain 2 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} and remove 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
escalations.flavorText: Every institution receives the capability. The author of the standard retains the trust, interpretation, and service relationship.

escalations.name: Narrative Capture
escalations.text: Remove 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}, gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway}, or add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} to a player with more ${terms.playerTracks.customers}.
escalations.flavorText: The ${terms.locations.media}, ${terms.locations.capital}, and ${terms.locations.government} adopt the institution’s preferred account of what has become necessary.

escalations.name: ${terms.technology.agentSwarm}
escalations.text: Resolve two different unused Core Actions without an additional move. Exhaust both and add 3 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
escalations.flavorText: Bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, establish reporting lines, and begin requesting objectives.

escalations.name: ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}
escalations.text: Era IV Program. On ${terms.locations.grid}, spend ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.runwayCost} ${terms.resources.runway}. Place the sole shared Fusion marker in a legal Generator slot. It is an additional Generator that connects your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Score ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.mandate} ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} and add ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.scrutiny} ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Only one Fusion may be built.
escalations.flavorText: The device produces power, Mandate, and several competing definitions of public benefit.
